title: The Subgroup H Sigma Plus And The Character Psi Beta
body_html:
The Subgroup H Sigma Plus And The Character Psi Beta

The theta draft defines a subgroup recursively by the length of the brick decomposition:

$$ H_{\Sigma,x,+} := G_{x,s^+}\,H_{\Sigma_a,x_a,+}, $$

where $\Sigma_a$ denotes the lower-depth remainder after removing the maximal depth brick, and $s$ is half the depth of the top brick.

The draft says $H_{\Sigma,x,+}$ is the largest subgroup of $G_{x,0+}$ on which the function

$$ \psi_\beta(C(X)):=\psi(\operatorname{tr}(X\beta)) $$

restricts to a character.

Draft Caution

The notation $C(X)$ and the exact Cayley-transform convention are not defined in this local section. This node records the intended role of $H_{\Sigma,x,+}$ rather than a complete standalone construction.
